vanguard_basic.name: Shield Bash
vanguard_basic.desc: Quick shield strike. Landing it lets you cancel into Ground Breaker or Retaliate.

ground_breaker.name: Ground Breaker
ground_breaker.desc: Smash the ground: launches enemies and sends a shockwave.
ground_breaker.tip: Hit them as they jump or approach.

retaliate.name: Retaliate
retaliate.desc: Spend ALL Bulwark: damage grows with the amount spent (up to +24).
retaliate.tip: Wait until Bulwark is high. Needs 30.

shield_rush.name: Shield Rush
shield_rush.desc: Charge forward with the shield raised, knocking enemies back.
shield_rush.tip: Close the gap or escape pressure.

bastion.name: Titan's Bastion
bastion.desc: Shield yourself AND nearby allies (-60% damage, 4s) and blast nearby enemies away.
bastion.tip: Use when your team is being pressured.

duelist_basic.name: Rapier Thrust
duelist_basic.desc: Fast thrust. Each hit builds Momentum.
duelist_basic.tip: Chain into Quick Slash when it connects.

quick_slash.name: Quick Slash
quick_slash.desc: Three rapid slashes. Great for stacking Momentum.

phantom_step.name: Phantom Step
phantom_step.desc: Dash through enemies; your next hit deals x1.8. With 3+ Momentum, Quick Slash is refunded.
phantom_step.tip: Cross up an enemy, then punish.

sidestep.name: Sidestep
sidestep.desc: Short invulnerable step. Can cancel any attack's recovery.

thousand_cuts.name: Thousand Cuts
thousand_cuts.desc: Blink to the nearest enemy and cut eight times. Consumes your Momentum bonus into the finishing blow.
thousand_cuts.tip: Use it on a staggered enemy.

ranger_basic.name: Arrow
ranger_basic.desc: Quick arrow. Stand still 0.7s first for +50% damage.

piercing_shot.name: Piercing Shot
piercing_shot.desc: Heavy arrow that pierces up to 5 targets.

hunters_mark.name: Hunter's Mark
hunters_mark.desc: Mark an enemy for 6s: your damage to them is +25% and your ultimate charges faster.

shadow_dash.name: Shadow Dash
shadow_dash.desc: Leap backwards with brief invulnerability and gain speed.

arrow_storm.name: Arrow Storm
arrow_storm.desc: Rain arrows over the target for 10 volleys. Marked enemies take +25%.
arrow_storm.tip: Enemies can simply walk out - zone them in.

explosive_round.name: Explosive Round
explosive_round.desc: Slow shell that explodes on contact. Costs 2 rounds.

dead_eye.name: Dead Eye
dead_eye.desc: Fire a six-bullet fan. For 5s you have infinite ammo and +25% damage.
dead_eye.tip: Open with the fan, then unload.

arcanist_basic.name: Elemental Orb
arcanist_basic.desc: Orb of the attuned element. Costs 6 mana.
arcanist_basic.tip: Frost slows, Fire burns, Storm chains.

arcane_bolt.name: Arcane Bolt
arcane_bolt.desc: Homing bolt of the attuned element. Costs 18 mana.
arcane_bolt.tip: Frost first, then Fire bolt to Shatter.

attune.name: Attune
attune.desc: Cycle element: Fire (+20% dmg), Frost (slows), Storm (chains). Fire on a slowed enemy = Shatter x1.5.

cataclysm.name: Cataclysm
cataclysm.desc: A colossal meteor crashes on the target after a long warning, slowing survivors.
cataclysm.tip: Slow them first so they cannot leave.

shadeweaver_basic.name: Void Lash
shadeweaver_basic.desc: Scythe sweep. Damage grows with Shadow (up to +40%).
shadeweaver_basic.tip: Stay moving to keep Shadow high.

binding_chains.name: Binding Chains
binding_chains.desc: Chains that root the target for 1.4s. Rooted foes are then immune to roots for 2.5s.

shadow_echo.name: Shadow Echo
shadow_echo.desc: Teleport forward, leaving an echo. Press again within 3s to swap back. An unused echo bursts when it fades.

rift_blink.name: Rift Blink
rift_blink.desc: Blink through the Rift and burst on exit. Gives +10 Shadow.

eclipse.name: Eclipse
eclipse.desc: A wave of darkness roots every enemy nearby for 1.3s after a clear wind-up.
eclipse.tip: Hit them while they are rooted.

rift_cut.name: Rift Cut
rift_cut.desc: Quick dimensional cut. Hits from behind the target deal +30%.

dimensional_slash.name: Dimensional Slash
dimensional_slash.desc: Fires a crescent of torn space that pierces two enemies.
dimensional_slash.tip: Poke from range before you teleport in.

rift_step.name: Rift Step
rift_step.desc: Open a rift and step out BEHIND the nearest enemy with an immediate backstab (+30% from behind).
rift_step.tip: A ring marks the exit during the wind-up.

phase_dash.name: Phase Dash
phase_dash.desc: Slip through space in a short invulnerable dash.
phase_dash.tip: Dodge, then Rift Step behind them.

rift_collapse.name: Rift Collapse
rift_collapse.desc: A collapsing rift drags every enemy nearby toward you and crushes them.
rift_collapse.tip: Walk out of the ring during the wind-up to avoid it.

guard_strike.name: Guard Strike
guard_strike.tip: Push enemies out of your ward's reach of allies.

sanctuary_pulse.name: Sanctuary Pulse
sanctuary_pulse.desc: Burst of holy force that shoves nearby enemies away.
sanctuary_pulse.tip: Peel enemies off yourself or an ally.

guardian_ward.name: Guardian Ward
guardian_ward.desc: Plant a ward for 6s: you and allies inside take 35% less damage.

aegis_dome.name: Aegis Dome
aegis_dome.desc: A great dome for 5s: allies inside take 60% less damage; enemies nearby are blasted back.
aegis_dome.tip: Stand in it to win a team fight.

spark.name: Spark
spark.desc: Small bolt of electricity. Every hit adds Charge.

lightning_bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
lightning_bolt.desc: Very fast bolt. Adds extra Charge.

discharge.name: Discharge
discharge.desc: Spend ALL Charge: chain lightning strikes up to 3 enemies in range, stronger with more Charge.

static_dash.name: Static Dash
static_dash.desc: Dash in a flash of static. Gives +20 Charge.
static_dash.tip: Dash through the fight to recharge.

tempest.name: Tempest
tempest.desc: A storm settles over the target and strikes six times.
tempest.tip: Leave the marked ring to avoid it.

reaper_basic.name: Scythe Sweep
reaper_basic.desc: Wide sweep. Hits give Souls and heal a little (capped).

soul_rend.name: Soul Rend
soul_rend.desc: Heavy reaping arc with +10 extra Souls on hit.
soul_rend.tip: Burst option: use it when they are staggered.

soul_siphon.name: Soul Siphon
soul_siphon.desc: Spend ALL Souls to heal (8 + 20% of Souls, max 24). Total healing is limited over time.
soul_siphon.tip: Recovery option: use it when low.

wraith_step.name: Wraith Step
wraith_step.desc: Drift forward as a wraith, untouchable for a moment.

deaths_harvest.name: Death's Harvest
deaths_harvest.desc: Reap everything nearby; heal 40% of the damage dealt (inside the healing limit).
deaths_harvest.tip: Walk out of the ring in the wind-up to avoid it.

chrono_bolt.name: Chrono Bolt
chrono_bolt.desc: Bolt of compressed seconds. Hits restore a little Time energy.

time_snare.name: Time Snare
time_snare.desc: Slows the target to half speed for 3s.

temporal_bubble.name: Temporal Bubble
temporal_bubble.desc: A bubble for 4s: enemies inside are slowed and enemy projectiles crawl.
temporal_bubble.tip: Place it on a doorway or on top of yourself.

time_skip.name: Time Skip
time_skip.desc: Skip forward or back a short distance (move with the stick).

hourglass.name: Hourglass
hourglass.desc: Time stutters: nearby enemies are slowed for 3s while you gain haste and 3s off every cooldown.

sic_em.name: Sic 'Em
sic_em.desc: Command the wolf to lunge at the nearest enemy. Needs the wolf out.
sic_em.tip: The target can dodge the marked spot.

call_of_pack.name: Call of the Pack
call_of_pack.desc: Call (or refresh) your wolf for 10s. It follows you and bites nearby enemies.
call_of_pack.tip: Keep it out as much as you can.

pounce.name: Pounce
pounce.desc: Leap forward with the claws out.

alpha_howl.name: Alpha Howl
alpha_howl.desc: Howl: knocks back nearby enemies, calls the wolf, and sends the pack into a 6s FRENZY (wolf x2 damage, faster bites, you gain haste).
